method.selection: Hand-picked: the large online pharmacies and private clinic chains we know of in Finland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany and the UK. Sites whose home page didn't answer a plain request at all were left out. Corrections and additions are welcome as GitHub issues.
method.terms: Pharmacies: 'pregnancy test' in the site's language. Clinics: 'depression'. Both are ordinary searches about health.
method.phases: before: the cookie banner is never touched. after: its accept button is clicked first. reject: its reject button is clicked first. Each phase runs in a fresh browser with no cookies.
method.answered_via: How the banner was answered, per site: 'button' (the consent tool's known button), 'text' (a button found by its label) or 'api' (the consent tool's own accept/reject call, used only when no button could be clicked).
method.user_agent: Headless Chromium with its user agent changed from 'HeadlessChrome' to 'Chrome', so sites behave as they do for a visitor's Chrome: some consent tools treat headless browsers differently. One visit per phase and run, no more than three sites at a time.
method.anonymised: Sites are labelled by type and country on purpose: the point is the pattern, not any one company.
